notes.title: Cyberpunk Red: Combat Zone
notes.content:
We've just released Cyberpunk Red: Combat Zone into beta test. This is included in the base package of Wartop and free for play. 

This includes the same content as the 2 player starter as well as the pledge miniatures. Loot, gear, and netdecks are all present. 

Please drop by our discord with any feedback you have on the system and any qualify of life functions you'd like to see. 

We've also included the limiter as well as a spawnable overlay for quick movement. Due to control limitations, the limiter works in multiple stages: 

1. Spawn the limiter and rotate it around the model
2. left click to lock rotation
3. Mouse wheel to switch between horizontal or vertical limiter
4. left click to lock orientation
5. mouse wheel to bend the limiter under your cursor 

After moving your miniature you can right click the limiter to remove it. 

The number 2 token spawning menu allows you to hit a drop down for the numbered tokens

notes.title: PDF Viewer Added
notes.content:
As an interim patch while we continue to work on the map editor, we've released a PDF viewer. 

This PDF viewer is for viewing local PDFs on your machine. It does not allow you to share PDFs with other users, it just lets you bring them into the viewer so that you can reference them when playing on the sandbox table. You and a friend have the same PDF? you can both load it up and have a game. 

To find it go to the tools menu and look for the PDF option. This will pop it up, click it again to remove it. It has a side panel, working search, and will remember the last page you had it open to even if you load it later.

notes.title: UI Overhaul
notes.content:
Today you'll notice a new UI in Wartop. We've begun and overhaul to improve the flow, layout and also add a few more things in. We're starting with the main game UI that you see the most. The big long menu on the left is gone. Instead you will find a row of icons across the top of the screen. These drop you down into various categories where you can choose what you need. Currently we have these menus:

[list]
[*]Spawning - models, terrain, accessories and choosing a map
[*]Measuring - For single measurement and waypoint measuring
[*]Tools - Includes things like locking the terrain, reseting the activation tool, choosing your player area, the location pinger.
[*]Save/options - This includes loading and saving a game, saving out prefabs, and the options menu
[/list]

The left hand menu has been changed to a document icon, and this menu will hold any resources that are unique to the individual game. So things like rules, quick references, army builders, deployment zones, etc. can still be found there. 

This is just a start as we work our way through and improve the UI across the platform. As always, do stop by our discord and leave us some feedback. We listen to all suggestions and implement as many as we can.

notes.title: Wartop Now & Forever
notes.content:
Welcome to the Wartop Now & Forever Update

You might be wondering what it is that means. We know as the the new kids on the block a lot of people aren't sure about our platform. They might worry that if we shut down sometime in the future they'll lose access to the games and content they've collected. We wanted to address that in a couple of ways. 

First up, we have no intention of shutting down. Wartop is something we believe in, and we'll work on it as long as we're able to. It might take awhile to reach the heights of other platforms, but for us, that's fine. All good things had to start somewhere. 

Secondly, this update adds a couple of features. So long as you have logged into Wartop once after adding any content, your content will be cached. If our servers are ever offline, the game will default to using the cached version of your content rather than retrieving a recent list. We use Epic Online Services for the backend, but let's imagine Fortnite falls on hard times, and Tim Sweeney finds himself panhandling on the corner. We've just implemented a Direct IP join option. You'll see this now after you choose a game system. So long as the internet uses IP addresses you should be fine to play Wartop. You could also play it on a LAN if that happened, but honestly if you're in the same LAN as someone just play the real game. 

Finally, the apocalypse has come. Epic is gone, Amazon's servers have died and even Steam itself collapses, no problem. While the game currently creates your online presence using your Steam account in the event that Steam is no longer available, it will provide you with an alternate way to identify yourself. 

While this is already a cool update, we've added a few more things in this update as well. 

[list]
[*]A new colour wheel. This is more compact, and it's also been made more dynamic so that we can use it on more things that just units. We've also added the ability to paste in a hex colour code so you can bring in your favourite colour.
[*]The beginnings of terrain that can be customized. If you jump into the Bloodfields starter and find the Flag objective item, and hold tab while right clicking it, it'll bring up the colour wheel and you can customize the colours of the flag for your battle. 
[*]We've also been experimenting with colouring and texturing terrain in Bloodfields, check out the short fence and a couple fo the large rocks we've gone through and put a few experimental materials on it, let us know what you think. 
[*]A little more control when dropping tokens and units. If you drop a unit on a slanted surface, it may bounce around a bit. Just part of the physics. What you can now do, is hold shift and this will help constrain it so that when it hits the ground it will remain much more stable. 
[*]We've added a button you can use to straighten tokens after picking them up. We don't automatically change the facing of tokens when picking them up because some games have tokens you have to flip to one side or the other. If you'd like to reset the rotation of a token while holding it, just hit the left alt key. This will force it to reset to the default orientation if it gets twisted around. 
[/list]

To help illustrate all of this we've managed to cram a bunch of these things directly into a single screen shot.

notes.title: Bloodfields Free Starter & Updates
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

We've been squirrelling away here fixing a number of bugs, and adding in some new features, as well as new content. 

We're very happy to present the Bloodfields Starter from Titan Forge. We will be bringing the entire line-up to Wartop with all armies, plus the mercenaries. For now the starter is part of the base package in Wartop. 

Bloodfields has one of our new features included which are deployment zones. Using the deployment zone menu you can cycle through the various deployment zones that may be appropriate for this system. This will be rolled out to other games as well. These overlays make it very easy to see exactly where you need to place your units to get a game going, especially if there is anything unique about the deployment. Bloodfield's vortex game mode is easy to handle using these deployment zones. 

We're also introducing Decks as an item. We previously had decks as a static object on a table, but as some of the new games we're working on in the background have numerous decks we've now expanded these out to full spawnable objects. 

[olist]
[*]Long click to pick up and move, Q/E to rotate
[*]Click and pull to draw a card to your hand
[*]Right click to access the ability to draw to discard, draw face down, face up, or search the deck which allows you to see the full contents of the deck and pull cards out or drop cards in and even change the order of cards. 
[/olist]

Do visit us on discord to keep up on the release schedule for the Bloodfields Armies or to give us any feedback. We want to hear what you like, what you don't like. We're developing this for the community and the best way to do that is with your feedback. With Bloodfields having 25 armies, let us know your favourite and help us decide the order that we process them.

notes.title: Updates Updates Updates
notes.content:
You may have noticed several small updates over the last couple weeks. 

We've been busy behind the scenes putting in new features, and fixing some bugs. 

Let's run through them: 

[list]
[*]A toggle in the options to allow you to change the camera mode. Currently the default camera is a first person flying camera. You can hold down shift so that your camera slides around on the current plane rather than fly up and down. You can now go into the options and swap that behaviour, so that the default is sliding on the plane and holding shift allows you to fly freely. 
[*]Players names will float above the avatar head
[*]You can rotate dice to any face now, just right click the dice and select the face option
[*]Save/Load - We've added a save and load for in progress games. This will save all miniatures, attached tokens, other tokens, dice, and terrain. When loading you can choose to load on top of existing assets on the tables, or replace assets with what's in the same. The save will not save out fixed tokens or decks. 
[*]You can multiselect all kinds of assets now, not just dice. You can also set the colours specifically for all miniatures selected at once, allowing you to quickly swap their colours. 
[*]We've added a new quick measurement tool. The old one is still there listed as 'waypoints' the new one allows you to just quickly click drag and release. This will measure and then send the measurement to chat. You can also access this with the hotkey 'm'
[*]We've added highlights around selected miniatures
[*]We've updated the in-game control reference screen to match the one from the main menu
[*]Items can be picked up with variable height, just pick up an item, hold down shift and use the mousehweel to adjust the height. This will be saved for the session. 
[*]The options menu is now accessible from the in-game menu during play
[*]Miniatures and objects now lift directly off the table, rather than snap to the mouse. This means they will not drift around on the x,y axis until you move the mouse. 
[*]Claim Unit Function - You can click a miniature you don't own and then select 'claim unit' to assign this unit to you during play. 
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Made floating tokens larger and easier to read
[*]we adjusted the right click menu so that it wouldn't pop up after moving the camera if you happened to end over something that has a right click menu
[*]We fixed some issues related to colour replication
[*]we adjust the time required to pick up units on a long press. It now picks them up a bit faster
[*]We fixed some issues related to using the R key for rolling dice and the G key for marking an indicator on the table while holding multiple items
[*]We enabled the send button on the chat UI, previously you just pushed enter after typing and then it sent, now you can click the send button as well if you like. 
[/list]

We've also done a ton of behind the scenes clean-up to enable us to build out more features and currently have a list longer than our arms of things we want to add and build out. So do keep your eyes pealed for more!

Also new factions for Revelations: Skirmish were released in the midst of this. Check out our site to find out more.

notes.title: Revelations: Skirmish Free Starter
notes.content:
Hello,

We have another free starter added to the platform today. This comes in the form of Revelations: Skirmish. If you like big stompy robots in 12mm scale, then this is the game for you. 

[i]
Revelations: Skirmish is a fast-paced, reactive table-top combat game. Each player builds their force of infantry, drones, vehicles, and powerful WarMechs to achieve victory on the battlefield.[/i]

Revelations: Skirmish also marks our first game using live stats. Every time you fire up the army builder, it will take a couple of seconds to pull the live unit stats and information directly from their website and make sure what you're using is the most up to date version. It also comes with a selection of buildings, hills, and some scatter terrain groups of trees to build out your map. 

If you would like to find out more about the game, including lore check [url=https://revelationswar.com/]out their main site. [/url]

Hello everyone, 

We're back with some more free content added to the Wartop Base package. The GunCraze starter has been added. This comes from Action Tactics Roleplay Gaming, and you can check out[url=https://www.guncraze.net] their site[/url] for more information on the game and the roleplaying game. They describe the skirmish game as:

[quote]Welcome to the exhilarating world of GunCraze Miniature Battles, an action-packed skirmish game that brings the intensity of combat to your tabletop. Powered by the GunCraze Action Tabletop Roleplaying System, this game pits players against each other in heart-pounding combat scenarios. Prepare to unleash your tactical prowess as you run, jump, climb, and charge across the game mat, engaging in exhilarating battles where every move counts.[/quote]

We've set up the base game with the following features: 
[list]
[*]2 Teams of 4 miniatures along with faction cards and unit cards, and a team trackers specifically for Guncraze.
[*]A new 36" x 24" plain white grid map that can be used on any table, this will be expanded with other sizes in the future. 
[*]A terrain set based on a warehouse. This includes several shelf configurations, scatter terrain, and some walls and doors set up with snap building to help you build out rooms if you like. 
[*]All the rules and tokens required for play
[/list]

We will be expanding the terrain set out more with additional scatter terrain and further shelf configurations to help you build more maps. 

We've also added a feature that lets you independently spawn the cards of units that come with them. So for games like Nebula, Guncraze, and DLC games like Zoontalis: Battle Royale and Invaders of Zylon you can spawn both the models and cards without needing to open the army builders again.

notes.title: Duel - Free Content Update
notes.content:
Hello All, 

Another game added to the base package today. This is a game called 'Duel' in which you can have quick, simple 1 v 1 western shoot-outs, but also build out a larger posse and play in a larger area. This free content is coming with a couple of new things. 

First up is the premade map. We thought it'd be interesting to drop this in and see what the players though of it. We have lots of maps where you can have a flat top and drop terrain on it, but how about a full premade environment like this? Scatter terrain is still included so you can customize areas of it, but due to the way it's built out, it's not so easy to spawn and place new buildings. The uneven terrain makes it hard to settle them. We may include a button to switch to a flat table so you can build out your own layout on tables like this if you wish. 

Secondly, due to the type of table this is, we've included a spawnable map token on the side menu. When you spawn this you get a token that lays out a 1'x1' play area. You can right click the token to change to 2'x2' or 3'x3'. You can then move this around (including rotating it with Q and E) and place it anywhere within the playable area to mark out where you plan to have your battle. 

Let us know what you think. If there is interest, we can include more tables like this.

notes.title: Wartop Release and Updates
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

We wanted to let everyone know that Wartop will be releasing imminently as we iron out a couple of bugs and verify that everything is ready for this initial release. 

We also wanted to lay out our plans for the future of Wartop and how we're going to approach this. While we have no marked this game as early access, the game is by no means finished. We have so much content coming in the form of new game systems, assets like models and terrain as well as building more features into the game itself. 

What is coming in the base game? The base game will include 2 full games, Many Ages and The Streets of Erekh. These are both fantasy based skirmish games and come with enough terrain and miniatures for a couple of people to get started playing. The fulls for both games are in there, along with some quality of life automations for various facets of the games. 

Our launch line up of available game systems that can be purchased includes:

[list]
[*]Deadzone From Mantic Games
[*]Zoontalis: Battle Royal from Dice Heads
[*]Invaders of Zylon from Foxcraft
[*]Ultracombat from Dishdash Radio
[/list]

The response from the industry has been very large and we have a significant line-up of games and systems coming to the platform. We've also partnered with miniature and terrain makers to bring their assets to the platform as well. 

We aren't only going to be bringing paid content to the platform. There will also be several more free game systems implemented that will make up the base version of the product. This includes the Nebula Starter Set from Cast N Play, and we'll be adding free terrain and miniatures to support various themes. There is a Sandbox area you can use that does not have any specific built in rule sets to play games you might own the books or PDFs for with your friends. Do stay tuned as there is a lot of exciting things coming. 

In terms of features we won't be putting a full road map in this post, however we building things like a unit builder for systems that provide their miniatures in modular pieces, we're looking at full terrain and model painters to help customize your game, and we're going to be expanding the way that army builders work and how you can build up your army, army sheets, maps and other assets before games so that they're ready and sorted the way you want. 

Most importantly though is we want to hear feedback from the community as we'll be using that to help shape the road map and things we add to the game.
